lede: The school board votes Monday on a flood-damage budget appropriation for FY 2026-27 — real money being shifted to cover what the San Miguel River did to TIS, TMHS, and the Palm Theatre complex this summer. Alongside that, the Ethics Commission takes up a formal Code of Conduct recommendation for Town officials on Tuesday, and the Telluride Hospital District board considers possible action on a Two Site Model that would define what gets built and where for the new medical facility.

notable.stake: Board votes to adjust district budget to cover summer flood damage costs.
Commission recommends whether Town officials get a binding Code of Conduct.
Board may act on Two Site Model shaping the new hospital's scope and location.
CCAP childcare funding shortfall could affect county Human Services budget.
TMVOA votes on workforce housing committee and updated association policies.
